headline: St. Mary's Boat Club could be rebuilt to stop the flooding. The city wants your input Tuesday
dek: A Nov. 3 open house is the first public look at plans for the flood-prone waterfront facility.

facts.v: St. Mary's Boat Club, 1641 Fairfield Road, Halifax

body: The Halifax Regional Municipality is planning to redevelop the St. Mary's Boat Club, and it wants to hear from residents before any designs are drawn.

The building regularly floods, which the city links to rising sea levels, extreme tides and major storms. The redevelopment is meant to make the historic waterfront facility more resilient to climate change, easier to get into and around, and sustainable over the long term.
The project is still in pre-design, so there is no plan to react to yet. What residents say at the open house will help shape what gets designed.
means: If you use the boat club or live nearby, Tuesday evening is the earliest chance to influence the design.
Can't make it? The city will post project updates at halifax.ca/smbc.
